_meta.title: ODIN PDUFA Approval Probability Scoring System — Complete Specification

best_metrics.note: v1100 walk-forward metrics; v1108 adds interactions, currently honing

_meta.author: David (architect) + Claude (engineering lead)
_meta.purpose: Score FDA PDUFA events for biotech catalyst trading. Predict P(Approval). The runup IS the trade — exit T-5 (Tier 1-2) or T-7 (Tier 3). NEVER hold through binary.

scoring_algorithm.step_1: Build 54-element feature vector from raw event inputs (see feature_engineering)
scoring_algorithm.step_2: Dot product: logit = sum(feature[i] * weight[i] for i in 0..53)
scoring_algorithm.step_4: Tier assignment based on probability thresholds

v1066_canonical_weights._note: IMMUTABLE — these are the original 33 validated weights. Never modify.

v1070_extension_weights._note: Added in v10.70 — 15 new weights for era effects, gene therapy, psychedelics, etc. These are ADDITIVE to v1066.

v1108_interaction_weights._note: 6 interaction features (indices 48-53). These capture non-linear compound effects. Currently being honed — anchor values shown.

ix_prior_crl_x_mfg_risk.description: Prior CRL + still have manufacturing problems = guaranteed CRL

ix_prior_crl_x_form483.description: Prior CRL + Form 483 issues — 99% overlap with ix_prior_crl_x_mfg_risk

ix_gene_therapy_x_mfg_risk.description: Gene therapy CMC is already hard; add mfg risk = brutal

ix_inexperienced_x_mfg_risk.description: No playbook for fixing manufacturing problems

ix_single_arm_x_surrogate.description: APPROVAL signal — accelerated rare disease pathway, FDA already lenient

ix_btd_x_single_arm.description: APPROVAL signal — BTD blessed the single-arm design

feature_engineering._note: How to build the 54-element feature vector from raw event data. Order matters — index must match weight index.

features.name: snda_base_penalty
features.value: 1.0 if sBLA/sNDA/SUPPL and NOT pediatric, else 0.0

features.name: odin_weight
features.value: 0.65 (prior estimate — placeholder when no prior ODIN score exists)

features.name: ta_high_risk_penalty
features.value: 1.0 if ta_base_score < -0.10 (CNS, Neurology, Ophthalmology, Pain, Nephrology)

features.name: ta_low_risk_boost
features.value: 1.0 if ta_base_score >= 0.0 (Oncology, Immunology, Dermatology, Infectious Disease)

features.name: eu_approved_2026_penalty
features.value: 1.0 if EU approved AND year >= 2026 (Hoeg era reduces EU signal value)

features.name: hoeg_era_constant
features.value: 1.0 if catalyst_date >= 2025-01-01 (Hoeg era FDA = more stringent)

features.name: ta_very_high_boost
features.value: 1.0 if TA in (Respiratory, GI/Hepatology, Dermatology, Infectious Disease, Immunology)

honing_architecture._note: The honing engine continuously optimizes weights via random perturbation + selection on validation Brier score.

sign_constraints.description: Penalties must stay negative, boosts must stay positive. Prevents nonsensical weight flips.

ta_base_scores._note: Therapeutic area base scores (ta_base_score field). Negative = higher CRL risk.

historical_crl_rates._note: Historical CRL rates by TA — used for hint_crl_rate_penalty and hint_weight features.

dataset_schema._note: Required input fields for scoring an event. All must be T1-compliant (available before catalyst_date).

fields.therapeutic_area: TA category (string — see ta_base_scores for valid values)
fields.prior_crl: Has this specific drug received a prior CRL? (boolean)
fields.sponsor_prior_approvals: Number of prior FDA approvals by sponsor (float, 0+)
fields.form_483_issues: FDA Form 483 observations at manufacturing site? (boolean)
fields.had_adcom: Was there an Advisory Committee meeting? (boolean)
fields.adcom_vote_pct: AdCom favorable vote percentage (float 0-100, 0 if no adcom)
fields.s22_ped_pk_missing: Missing pediatric PK data per S22 requirements? (boolean)
fields.historical_crl_rate: Historical CRL rate for this TA (see historical_crl_rates lookup)
fields.gene_therapy: Is this a gene therapy product? (boolean)
fields.surrogate_endpoint: Was approval based on surrogate endpoint? (boolean)

trading_rules.core_principle: The RUNUP is the trade. Never hold through the binary event.
trading_rules.entry_window: T-25 to T-15 (no entry after T-15 — late entries capture <58% of move)

exit_rules.TIER_1: Exit T-5 (5 trading days before PDUFA)
exit_rules.TIER_3: Exit T-7 (7 trading days before PDUFA)
exit_rules.TIER_4: NO TRADE — no exceptions regardless of revenue impact

trading_rules.dead_money_rule: T-7 to T-1 is dead money. The bulk of the runup happens T-25 to T-7.
trading_rules.weekend_pdufa: If PDUFA falls on Saturday/Sunday/Monday, exit Thursday/Friday before.

HOEG_ERA.stance: Most stringent — Dr. Marty Makary era, increased CRL rates, skepticism of surrogates and accelerated approval

key_signals_by_importance._note: Ranked by absolute weight magnitude (v1066 canonical). These are the most impactful features.

top_penalties.name: prior_crl_penalty
top_penalties.interpretation: Prior CRL is the single strongest negative signal — 3.2 logits of penalty

top_penalties.name: s22_pediatric_pk_penalty
top_penalties.interpretation: Missing pediatric PK = almost certain CRL

top_penalties.name: ema_cmc_flag_penalty
top_penalties.interpretation: EMA CMC issues = FDA will find them too

top_penalties.name: psychedelics_penalty
top_penalties.interpretation: Post-MDMA rejection, psychedelics face extreme scrutiny

top_penalties.name: inexperienced_sponsor_penalty
top_penalties.interpretation: First-time sponsors fail at higher rates

top_penalties.name: manufacturing_risk_penalty
top_penalties.interpretation: CMC is the #1 cause of CRLs

top_penalties.name: cmc_extension_penalty
top_penalties.interpretation: FDA needed more time on CMC = red flag

top_penalties.name: gene_therapy_penalty
top_penalties.interpretation: Gene therapies face unique manufacturing and durability concerns

top_boosts.name: adcom_high_boost
top_boosts.interpretation: Strong AdCom vote (≥65%) is the strongest positive signal

top_boosts.name: experienced_sponsor_boost
top_boosts.interpretation: 5+ prior approvals = institutional knowledge of FDA process

top_boosts.name: priority_review_weight
top_boosts.interpretation: Priority review = FDA sees meaningful advance

top_boosts.name: class1_resubmission_boost
top_boosts.interpretation: Class 1 resubmission (minor fix) after CRL = high approval

top_boosts.name: accelerated_approval_weight
top_boosts.interpretation: Accelerated pathway (pre-2025, before Hoeg era crackdown)

mcp_data_sources._note: Use these tools to populate real-time signal fields (s23, s6, social) before scoring.
mcp_data_sources.ClinicalTrials_MCP: Query for trial design, endpoints, enrollment, phase, NCT ID
mcp_data_sources.PubMed_MCP: Search for supporting publications, safety data, efficacy evidence
mcp_data_sources.ChEMBL_MCP: Look up compound details, mechanism of action, bioactivity data
mcp_data_sources.FinBrain_MCP: Insider trades (s23), analyst ratings, put/call ratios, sentiment
mcp_data_sources.LunarCrush_MCP: Social media sentiment, mentions, engagement for biotech tickers
mcp_data_sources.bioRxiv_MCP: Preprint research related to the drug's mechanism or target
mcp_data_sources.CMS_Coverage_MCP: Medicare coverage decisions (relevant for post-approval market sizing)
